body: Profile page had TWO visual layers: a fixed ChatProfilePageReflection (never scrolls, blurred bloom of the avatar) behind the ScrollView, plus the scrolling hero — that static backdrop is what read as 'disconnected'. Removed; media + identity + rows are now one scroll layer. The action row was also mounted twice (a circle copy in the flow and a pill copy on the hero, cross-faded by p); now ONE always-pill row.
author: Vibe Team
